evidence_summary: The 112.91% log return is a genuine listing-day move. Binance's daily candle closed at 17.822 versus Yahoo at 18.385660 (3.16% difference), and official spot trading opened on 2021-02-24 after an oversubscribed token sale.

The -131.84% log return is a genuine market crash. Binance's daily candle closed at 1.764 versus Yahoo at 1.770193 (0.35% difference); CoinGecko and contemporaneous reporting independently confirm the approximately 73% fall.

The 120.62% log return is a genuine event-driven move. CoinGlass independently reports OG's largest one-day gain (233.65% simple return) on the same date, and Binance announced the OG Launchpool and listing on 2020-12-23.
